name: Trips - Right - 32 Dive

QB.rule: Open right and hand to the tailback as he comes inside from the trips, then fake the boot left.

TB.rule: Come inside off the bunch, take the handoff between the right guard and the right tackle. One cut, then get north.

coaching_points: Dive is the B-gap — between the guard and the tackle. The tailback comes inside from the bunch and gets north.
